answer.rationale: Avoid promotional pricing: the recovered discount experiment increased qualified revenue but reduced 30-day retention by 12% and failed to survive renewal, conflicting with the sustainable-revenue objective. Referral incentives are the strongest available sustainable option, with confirmed gains in qualified revenue (+7%) and retention (+2%), though evidence is concentrated in accounts older than six months. Run the response within that established-customer segment rather than generalizing it to the broader SMB base.
